title: CORE-7345 · [RF] /compare-packages/llp/ — "Free Client Portal" and "Company Registers" feature-list items swapped vs Live
body:
Linear: https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7345/rf-compare-packagesllp-free-client-portal-and-company-registers

(Reference only — the ticket is the source of truth; fetch the live description at implement time.)

Imported by Planning 2026-09-04 as part of the board↔Linear sync: this ticket was open and assigned at Todo in Linear but had no row on the board.
acceptanceCriteria: At a true 360px viewport, the /compare-packages/llp/ feature-list order matches Live exactly: ... → Digital (Word) Draft LLP Agreement → Company Registers with First Entries → Free Client Portal to Manage Your Companies → Free Telephone Support → ... (Company Registers now appears BEFORE Free Client Portal at 360, reversing Clone's current order).

At 768px, 1024px and 1800px, the feature-list order is NOT regressed: Free Client Portal to Manage Your Companies still appears BEFORE Company Registers with First Entries at those breakpoints (Live's own order there, already matching pre-fix).

The fix is scoped to /compare-packages/llp/ only — /compare-packages/guarantee/ and any other compare-packages page's feature-list order is untouched (each page manages its own list order independently per the ticket).
